description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Regulations made to fix a method of determination of cost of freight of chartered vessels for Customs valuation purpose effective from 11.11.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification contains regulations under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that establish a method for determining cost of freight for customs valuation purposes. It represents a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for importers, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes - the focus is purely on establishing legal/regulatory procedures for customs valuation.
